name: XBITVault fail-open transfer authorization while unbound
summary: XBITVault keeps the XBIT balance ledger and its transfer(from,to,amount) only enforces msg.sender == xbitContract when xbitContract is non-zero. bindXBIT was never called, so anyone could move any holder's XBIT. The attacker moved 1,526,216,569.965537999999999998 XBIT out of the XBIT/USDT PancakeSwap pair, synced its XBIT reserve to 2 wei and sold XBIT back 20 times for the pair's USDT.
notes: Direct immutable vault; the fail-open check is in the deployed code and xbitContract was zero from construction through the exploit (bindXBIT never called), so no configuration change created the condition.

Exact USDT depletion of the XBIT/USDT pair 0xf019728561318141edde5255525df2cb57f6d6ff in the anchor transaction; the attacker supplied no USDT. The pair's pre-exploit liquidity came from a single addLiquidity (source-5). BSC-USD valued at par.
